description:
RED HORIZON: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

Red Horizon is an interactive, science-based survival simulation that puts children in command of a lunar or Martian outpost. Players must manage critical resources such as oxygen, water, food, power, and radiation protection while responding to unexpected emergencies and communication delays. By integrating real NASA datasets with scientifically grounded simulation mechanics, the game demonstrates how every decision impacts crew survival mission
summary:
### RED HORIZON: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

Red Horizon is an interactive, science-based survival simulation that puts children in command of a lunar or Martian outpost. Players must manage critical resources such as oxygen, water, food, power, and radiation protection while responding to unexpected emergencies and communication delays. By integrating real NASA datasets with scientifically grounded simulation mechanics, the game demonstrates how every decision impacts crew survival and mission success. Through engaging gameplay, cascading consequences, and interactive learning, Red Horizon makes the complexities of space exploration accessible and exciting for the next generation of explorers.
